auto_generated.purpose: Fixed the boundary-effect evaluation scoping bug (E7) — replaced union_all() with per-tile gpd.sjoin() at three sites in the evaluation pipeline, added 7 integration tests, and documented in protocol errata. Replaced three out-of-scope hard positive examples (fids 354, 249, 556) with genuine recognition failures (fids 399, 99, 15), prioritising recognition failures over localisation failures. Determined 128x128 crop size extracted from full map GeoTIFFs centred on target symbols (errata E8). Established documentation heuristic for decisions-log vs errata vs working-notes vs session-log.
